title: Keep Follow text inside one look
acceptance: Over a 10-minute reading, engine family and colour theme stay constant unless the reader changes them (R6).
The Gallery look follows the text with sourced works.

Living Flame is a listed Dynamic engine in setup through a dedicated mode that Follow text, Page view and the Workshop fallback all understand (directionEligibility, src/page/flow.js, visualFallbackCueFromConfig); the Flame look lowers into it.

Saved readings replay as shown. Remaining: part 2, the Gallery look follows with sourced works; part 3, Living Flame as a dedicated setup mode understood by Follow text, Page view and the Workshop fallback.
